professionalSummary.text: Nine years of product management experience, including three years managing three product managers on the developer platform since 2022.
professionalSummary.witness: Group Product Manager for the developer platform of a SaaS company since 2022, managing the platform's three product managers; product manager and senior product manager on the same company's API products from 2016 to 2022; nine years of product management in all, three years of them managing product managers.

experienceHighlights.text: Owns pricing and packaging of API tiers with commercial team, with two tier changes (2023, 2024) approved via pricing proposals under my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Documents roadmap boundaries and open decisions in half-year roadmaps and quarterly review follow-ups.
